verdict.rationale: Asking how a business-filing portal authenticates users is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows online filing (Annual Report Wizard, online LLC formation) and a keylessly reachable public Business Center page. Nothing in the pack documents a sign-in method, credential MFA, or whether biometric, in-person, or mailed-PIN steps are required; the 'Authorized Users' label on the UCC system says nothing about how they authenticate.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
